questions.q: What does ACID stand for in the context of Delta Lake?
options: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability
Access, Control, Identity, Data
Append, Commit, Index, Delete
Atomic, Concurrent, Immutable, Distributed
questions.explain: These are the classic guarantees a relational database makes about every transaction, now applied to files in cloud storage.

questions.q: How does Delta Lake handle two writers trying to commit at the same time?
options: Both proceed optimistically without locking, and a conflict is only checked and resolved at commit time
The table is locked so one writer must wait for the other to fully finish
The second writer's data is silently discarded with no error
Both writes are automatically merged together regardless of content
questions.explain: This is called optimistic concurrency — it resolves cleanly far more often than expected, since most concurrent writes don't actually conflict.

questions.q: What happens if writer B's commit doesn't actually conflict with writer A's, even though both targeted the same next version number?
options: Delta re-checks the change and lets B's commit become the next version automatically
B's write always fails regardless of whether there's a real conflict
A's commit is automatically rolled back to make room for B's
Both commits are combined into a single new version with no further checks
questions.explain: Only a real conflict causes B's write to fail with an error to retry.

questions.q: Why didn't Foundations' PySpark material need ACID vocabulary?
options: Nothing in that course wrote data more than once, concurrently, to the same location
ACID only applies to SQL databases, never to Spark
Foundations already used Delta Lake throughout without naming it
ACID guarantees are irrelevant to any data engineering work
questions.explain: Delta Lake specifically brings these guarantees to files in ordinary cloud storage, no database server required.

questions.q: Which mechanism enforces all four ACID guarantees in Delta Lake?
options: The numbered, append-only commits in the transaction log, read in strict order — from Lesson 17
A separate relational database running alongside the cluster
Photon acceleration
Unity Catalog access control grants
questions.explain: Every one of atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability traces back to this same log mechanism.
